description: This PHP source file defines the ModuleStatusChange event class within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It encapsulates the information about the change in status between two module instances, represented by Module objects. The class is used to handle events triggered when a module's status changes.

classes.name: ModuleStatusChange
classes.description: Represents a module status change event, storing references to previous and current Module objects.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of ModuleStatusChange with the previous and current Module objects.

methods.name: getPreviousModule
methods.description: Returns the Module object representing the previous state.

methods.name: getCurrentModule
methods.description: Returns the Module object representing the current state.
